title: Pourers and Casters, Metal
description: Operate hand-controlled mechanisms to pour and regulate the flow of molten metal into molds to produce castings or ingots.

tasks.text: Pour and regulate the flow of molten metal into molds and forms to produce ingots or other castings, using ladles or hand-controlled mechanisms.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on production flow control

dwas.name: Place materials into molds.
Adjust equipment controls to regulate flow of production materials or products.

tasks.text: Read temperature gauges and observe color changes, adjusting furnace flames, torches, or electrical heating units as necessary to melt metal to specifications.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Instrument monitoring needs physical sensor presence

dwas.name: Monitor instruments to ensure proper production conditions.
Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.

tasks.text: Remove solidified steel or slag from pouring nozzles, using long bars or oxygen burners.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of equipment in unstructured settings

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.

tasks.text: Examine molds to ensure they are clean, smooth, and properly coated.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical inspection of production machinery in situ

dwas.name: Inspect production equipment.

tasks.text: Collect samples, or signal workers to sample metal for analysis.

dwas.name: Collect samples of materials or products for testing.
Signal others to coordinate work activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Load specified amounts of metal and flux into furnaces or clay crucibles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on loading of materials into equipment

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.

tasks.text: Position equipment such as ladles, grinding wheels, pouring nozzles, or crucibles, or signal other workers to position equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Embodied signaling in shared physical workspace

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.
Signal others to coordinate work activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Skim slag or remove excess metal from ingots or equipment, using hand tools, strainers, rakes, or burners, collecting scrap for recycling.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

dwas.name: Trim excess material from workpieces.
Skim impurities from molten metal.

tasks.text: Transport metal ingots to storage areas, using forklifts.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving forklifts requires real-world navigation and control

dwas.name: Move products, materials, or equipment between work areas.
Operate forklifts or other loaders.

tasks.text: Assemble and embed cores in casting frames, using hand tools and equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mechanical assembly needs hands and tools

dwas.name: Assemble mechanical components or machine parts.

tasks.text: Turn valves to circulate water through cores, or spray water on filled molds to cool and solidify metal.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical valve/control manipulation for coolant

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate coolant flow.
Apply parting agents or other solutions to molds.

tasks.text: Pull levers to lift ladle stoppers and to allow molten steel to flow into ingot molds to specified heights.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on production flow control

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate flow of production materials or products.

tasks.text: Remove metal ingots or cores from molds, using hand tools, cranes, and chain hoists.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Removing workpieces from molds is physical

dwas.name: Remove workpieces from molds.

tasks.text: Repair and maintain metal forms and equipment, using hand tools, sledges, and bars.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual shaping and fitting of physical templates and molds

dwas.name: Repair templates, patterns, or molds.
Maintain production or processing equipment.

tasks.text: Add metal to molds to compensate for shrinkage.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual placement of materials into molds

dwas.name: Place materials into molds.

tasks.text: Stencil identifying information on ingots and pigs, using special hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Engraving requires controlled hand tool operation

dwas.name: Engrave designs, text, or other markings onto materials, workpieces, or products.
